accuracy.exterior: Independent 24 May 1941 reconstruction; revised from retained historical plan and neutral reference renders. Hull offsets and small fitting measurements remain interpreted.
accuracy.internals: Plate thicknesses and machinery sequence evidence-based; room boundaries and hull-conforming plate envelopes approximate. Standard-draft datum, not battle displacement.
accuracy.weapons: Independent gunhouse polygons; historical bore and turret frames. Simplified geometry and AP budget, no fuze, spall or material penetration model.
